channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: Jobs data and RBNZ hiking path – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects New Zealand’s Q2 labour data to broadly match the Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s May projections, which implied one to two hikes in Q3. He favours a hike in September or October, with rising conviction for September.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Holds steady near 0.5870 as bullish bias remains
item.description: The NZD/USD pair seesaws between tepid gains and minor losses through the first half of the European session on Tuesday, stalling the previous day's retracement slide from a two-month high – levels just above the 0.5900 mark.

item.title: Euro holds ground as Eurozone growth data offsets oil-driven CAD gains
item.description: EUR/CAD remains stronger for the eighth consecutive day, trading around 1.6170 during the European hours on Tuesday. The currency cross is holding its ground as the Euro (EUR) gains support from an uptick in market risk sentiment.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Joint intervention threat curtails selling – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the Japanese Yen has weakened modestly in Asia, with USD/JPY near its 200‑day moving average around 158.00 after recent joint intervention by Japan and the US.

item.title: Indian Rupee consolidates as RBI policy is in focus
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades flat at around 95.33 against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The Indian currency is expected to trade sideways as investors await the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) monetary policy announcement on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Needs to take out 1.1600 decisively for fresh upside
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades with caution at around Monday’s low of 1.1500 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Upside risk capped by 0.7075 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang reports AUD/USD briefly tested 0.7069 before retreating sharply to 0.6984, with the move seen as overdone. Intraday, the Australian Dollar is expected to range between 0.6980 and 0.7030.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Forming a triangle pattern above 1.4000 support area
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) stalls at the 1.4050 area against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) on Tuesday. The pair’s rebound from last week’s lows at the 1.3990 area failed to find follow-through above 1.4060, which leaves price action treading towards the peak of a descending triangle pattern.

item.title: US Dollar: Solid manufacturing and JOLTs in focus – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team underscores strong United States (US) cyclical signals, with the ISM manufacturing index rising to 55.6 in July, beating expectations and June’s reading. New orders, employment and production all improved, while prices moderated.

item.title: Gold extends range play above $4,050 as Fed hike bets and Iran risks underpin USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to attract any meaningful buyers and trades below the $4,100 mark during the first half of the European session on Tuesday as traders opt to wait for further developments surrounding the Middle East crisis.

item.title: Turkish Lira: July inflation and FX rules weigh on lira – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose notes Turkey’s July Consumer Price Index (CPI) slowdown to 31.7% year-on-year masks still-strong underlying price momentum, with smoothed headline and core inflation above 2% month-on-month.

item.title: CEE FX: Rates relief and CNB meeting – ING
item.description: ING strategist Frantisek Taborsky says Central and Eastern European markets opened positively, with rates markets outpricing hikes while FX stayed sidelined.

item.title: Dow Jones futures tick higher as easing Middle East tensions boost market sentiment
item.description: Dow Jones futures rise 0.17% to trade around 53,430 during European hours on Tuesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures gain 0.23% to trade near 7,650, while Nasdaq 100 futures advance 0.68%, trading near 29,090.

item.title: British Pound scales higher as fiscal concerns weigh on Yen
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross builds on the previous day's recovery move from the vicinity of mid-209.00s, or the lowest level in nearly five months, and gains some follow-through positive traction on Tuesday.

item.title: Experts agree: Last week’s intervention might have altered Yen outlook
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trims some gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, with the USD/JPY pair picking up to the mid-157.00s from Monday’s lows at 155.23.

item.title: United States Dollar holds gains amid Middle East uncertainty, hawkish Fed odds
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending its gains for the second successive day and trading around 100.00 during the European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Gains against US Dollar to remain limited – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists argue that recent Japanese Ministry of Finance (MoF) interventions and talk of joint United States (US)/Japan action have not changed the broader USD/JPY regime.

item.title: Brent: Sharp drop questions supply fears – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Senior Market Strategist Benjamin Picton notes Brent futures fell over 7% and Singapore gasoil nearly 11%, despite ongoing geopolitical and logistical disruptions to Oil and refined products.

item.title: British Pound: Pullback seen within 1.3400–1.3475 band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes GBP/USD reversed after an overbought spike to 1.3506, closing lower at 1.3434. The strategist sees scope for the pullback to extend but mainly within a 1.3400–1.3475 range, with a sustained drop below 1.3400 unlikely.

item.title: Euro stalls against British Pound as geopolitical uncertainty grips markets
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades practically flat, a few pips below 0.8570 against the British Pound (GBP) on Tuesday, holding moderate gains after Monday's bounce from last week's lows at 0.8542.

item.title: US Dollar: Warsh tactics cloud Fed path – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke discusses how new Fed Chair Warsh may be relying on markets to tighten financing conditions instead of raising rates, leaving the Dollar exposed to data-driven volatility.

item.title: Forex Today: Mideast uncertainty keeps USD supported ahead of next batch of US data
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, August 4:

item.title: Australian Dollar edges higher above 0.7000 on US-Iran breakthrough hopes
item.description: The AUD/USD pair gains momentum around 0.7020 during the early European session on Tuesday. Easing tensions in the Middle East improves risk sentiment and provides some support to the Australian Dollar (AUD) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Equities: Cyclical rotation extends as tech recovers – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that global equities began August with fresh all-time highs in several MSCI indices. Gains were driven by sector rotation, with software rebounding 16% over the past week and lower Oil prices supporting sentiment.

item.title: Oil: Deal optimism drives sharp selloff – ING
item.description: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil prices, including ICE Brent, fell sharply on optimism over a potential US–Iran Middle East deal.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD reaches $59.00 amid cautious Iran peace hopes
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) accelerates its recovery on Tuesday, reaching session highs above $59.00 at the time of writing, after bouncing from the $56.50 area on Monday.

item.title: Euro: Consolidation with upside trigger at 1.1565 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights EUR/USD’s recent sharp rise and subsequent consolidation after a failed attempt to sustain gains above 1.1558. Intraday, the Euro is expected to trade between 1.1485 and 1.1540, while a close above 1.1565 could open the way toward 1.1600.

item.title: Saudi Aramco CEO Nasser: Middle East crisis continues to aggravate supply shock
item.description: Saudi Aramco CEO Amin H. Nasser said during the European trading session on Tuesday that the ongoing geopolitical crisis continues to aggravate the biggest supply shock in history.

item.title: Canadian Dollar declines ahead of US JOLTS Job Openings data
item.description: The USD/CAD pair gains ground to near 1.4050 during the early European session on Tuesday. Traders continue to weigh the developments surrounding US-Iran talks. The US JOLTS Job Openings data is due later on Tuesday. On Friday, the US and Canadian July employment reports will be the highlights.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Downward-sloping trendline near 1.3470 remains key barrier
item.description: The British pound (GBP) faces selling pressure against its major currency peers, trading 0.1% lower at around 1.3420 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.
